notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - A Keystroke of Luck
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Keyboard Warriors! Patch 1.1.0 A Keystroke of Luck is the game's first major patch and introduces changes that provide players with more opportunities to customize and influence the gameplay, along with quality of life features, while climbing the tower of Verbum.


 Spells: choose a spell to cast during your climb. Will you choose healing, word skipping or temporary double damage?
 With the addition of spells mana is now a resource and intellect a new correlating stat. Defeating enemies has a chance to restore mana and the amount restored is upgradable at the Smith’s.
 Augmentations: an optional risk vs reward system to further customize your gameplay, one of which makes your typing streak have an impact on gameplay! 
 Space elevator: post game checkpoints beyond floor 300. 
 Added a gold sink at the smith to convert excess gold to ancient relics.
 Added tooltips with additional information on hover over item, spell or augmentation icons in-game and on the pause screen.
 Added a toggle all items button before climbing the tower.
 Additional settings added and revamped settings UI.
 Added 100+ new words to type throughout the various levels.
 Other neat fixes and improvements.


Found a pesky bug or just wanna chat about the game? Join the Discord Server and drop a message!
